title: Agents and marketplaces now gate discovery; our store must be agent-ready
summary: 55% of consumers use AI in product discovery (NIQ); 34% would use GenAI for gift ideas (Gartner). Walmart opened to outside AI agents with spending limits; Best Buy joined TikTok Shop; PC shipments fell 21% in Q3 (Counterpoint).

points.headline: AI agents are becoming a buying channel, and retailers are setting the rules
points.detail: Walmart opened to outside agents with profiles, terms and spending limits while Amazon blocks them; Meta pushes a shared standard. We should decide how agents read and buy from our store.

points.headline: Shoppers already start with AI, and may send agents to marketplaces first
points.detail: NIQ finds 55% use AI in discovery; Gartner says 34% would use GenAI for gifts; PYMNTS says shoppers would send agents to marketplaces over brand sites. Our product data and listings need to be agent-readable.

points.headline: PC demand is falling while memory costs lift prices and test financing
points.detail: PC shipments fell 21% in Q3 (Counterpoint) amid record price inflation; IDC is probing whether memory fears raise demand for flexible financing. We should plan Q4 pricing and test financing offers.

points.headline: Holiday channels are widening: longer Walmart events, Best Buy on TikTok Shop
points.detail: Walmart's Black Friday and Cyber Monday events run 14 days vs 10; Best Buy joined TikTok Shop; Adobe forecasts $275.1B online holiday sales. We should align our deal calendar and test TikTok Shop.
